summary: Items whose only reliable source in the base game is mining an ore, and what replaces mining in a NEW world made with the scarcity package (underground_city_scarcity: no natural ore in the overworld). A root with a route is obtainable without luck and without digging; a root with route null is needed by nothing the game offers as progression. docs/technical/hybrid-economy.md explains the audit; scripts/audit_item_sources.py enforces it. Existing worlds are never changed: they keep their ore, and this catalogue only states what a scarcity world promises.

routes_kinds.exchange: sold by a finite, shared regional-exchange line (content/gameplay/materials-supply.json): price, small shelf, slow refill, no stockpile
routes_kinds.derived: crafted from another root that has a route, by a base-game recipe

minecraft:iron_ingot.gameplay: the second and later backpack tiers, TaCZ guns and ammunition, vehicle parts, tools, locks, rails, anvils, hinges, every Machined Parts recipe

route.why: Ironhaven's foundries sell it cheapest; Valewood and Blackwater buy it in and sell it on at a premium. Small shelves, slow refill, no stockpile.

minecraft:iron_nugget.gameplay: the lockpick (two nuggets and a stick)

route.why: nine nuggets from one ingot by the base-game recipe

minecraft:coal.gameplay: furnaces and smelting chains, torches, the ammunition and gunpowder chain

route.why: Ironhaven's foundries sell furnace coal by the lump; Valewood also sells charcoal, which every recipe that takes coal and a torch accepts.
Valewood's charcoal burners; it can also be made in any furnace from logs.

minecraft:copper_ingot.gameplay: the copper backpack, Modern Life wiring, TaCZ and vehicle fittings, lightning rods

minecraft:redstone.gameplay: backpack upgrades (filters, pickup, restock), comparators, repeaters, Modern Life electronics, vehicle controls

route.why: Blackwater's electronics wholesalers import it by the sack.

minecraft:gold_ingot.gameplay: the gold backpack and the upgrade rings (eight ingots round a pack), clocks and compasses, powered rails

route.why: the harbour's bullion dealers: a few bars at a time at a high price.

minecraft:diamond.gameplay: the diamond backpack tier and the advanced upgrade rings, diamond tools

route.why: one gem every two active hours from the harbour's jewellers; a long-term purchase.

minecraft:netherite_ingot.mined_as: ancient debris (the Nether, which the scarcity package does not touch)
minecraft:netherite_ingot.gameplay: the top backpack tier (a trip to the Nether, D-102)
minecraft:netherite_ingot.note: The Nether is unchanged and untested: the netherite tier stays a deliberate trip there and is not part of the balanced economy. Listed here so that it is a stated limit, not an accident.
